name: kicc-visitor-registry
description: KICC visitor registration — Cloudflare Worker API on TiDB (MySQL) with a D1 fallback, plus a static front-end

scripts.deploy: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/test-data-layer.mjs && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:sqlite: wrangler d1 migrations apply kicc-registry --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:sqlite:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply kicc-registry --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:query: wrangler d1 execute kicc-registry --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --command "SELECT id, name, event_id, checked_in, created_at FROM registrations ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
